items.Sentence: A drum screen will be installed to provide primary treatment and protection of downstream processes.
The membrane bioreactor process combines activated sludge (secondary treatment) with membrane filtration (tertiary treatment)...
The treatment processes will include influent diversion and pumping, screening, an aeration tank, a membrane bioreactor process, and a chlorine disinfection system.
Disinfection will be accomplished utilizing a chlorine disinfection system consisting of two dosing pumps installed on a chemical feed skid...
